column1: 6.1.1 Preventive Maintenance. Preventive maintenance is systematic care, servicing
and inspection of the equipment to prevent the occurrence of trouble, to reduce downtime
and check that the system is always serviceable. The degradation / possibility of
occurrence of faults in the system are detected by going through appropriate routine
system checks. Some of these checks may require specific instruments for making test
